with order_items as (
    select 
        order_id :: varchar,
        order_item_id :: Numeric,
        product_id :: varchar,
        seller_id :: varchar,
        shipping_limit_date :: timestamp,
        price :: numeric,
        freight_value :: numeric
    from "ecommerce_db"."raw"."stg_order_items"
)

select
    md5(cast(coalesce(cast(order_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(order_item_id as TEXT), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as TEXT)) as order_item_key,
    order_id,
    order_item_id,
    seller_id,
    product_id,
    price,
    shipping_limit_date,
    freight_value
from order_items

     from "ecommerce_db"."raw"."stg_order_payments"
)

select
    order_id,
    payment_sequential,

    payment_value
from payments

with orders as (
    select 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_status,
        order_purchase_timestamp :: timestamp as order_purchase_timestamp,
        order_approved_at :: timestamp as order_approved_at,
        order_delivered_carrier_date :: timestamp as order_delivered_carrier_date,
        order_delivered_customer_date :: timestamp as order_delivered_customer_date,
        order_estimated_delivery_date :: timestamp as order_estimated_delivery_date
    from "ecommerce_db"."raw"."stg_orders"
)

select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    order_purchase_timestamp,
    order_approved_at,
    order_delivered_carrier_date,
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    order_estimated_delivery_date,
    
    -- Delivery Duration in Days
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) as days_to_deliver,
    
    -- Estimate Difference (Negative means delivered earlier than estimated)
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_estimated_delivery_date)) as delivery_delay_days,
    
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_estimated_delivery_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) as estimated_delivery_days,
    
    -- Operational Flag
    case 
        when order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date and order_status = 'delivered'then true 
        when order_delivered_customer_date < order_estimated_delivery_date and order_status = 'delivered'then false
        else null 
    end as is_delivery_delayed

from orders

)

        product_length_cm :: integer as product_length_cm,
        product_height_cm :: integer as product_height_cm,
        product_width_cm :: integer as product_width_cm
    from "ecommerce_db"."raw"."stg_products"
), 
translations as (
    select * from "ecommerce_db"."raw"."stg_product_category"
)

select
    p.product_id,
    coalesce(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') as product_category_name,
    p.product_name_length,
    p.product_description_length,
    p.product_photos_qty,
    coalesce(p.product_weight_g, 0) as product_weight_g,
    coalesce(p.product_length_cm, 0) as product_length_cm,
    coalesce(p.product_height_cm, 0) as product_height_cm,
    coalesce(p.product_width_cm, 0) as product_width_cm
from products p
left join translations t 
    on p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name

        order_id,

    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_order_payments"
)

with orders as (
    select 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_status,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_approved_at,
        o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
        o.days_to_deliver,
        o.delivery_delay_days,
        o.estimated_delivery_days,
        o.is_delivery_delayed
    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_orders" o
 ),
  order_review_agg as (
    select 
        order_id,
        avg(review_score) as avg_review_score,
        count(review_id) as total_reviews
    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_order_reviews"
    group by 1
  ),
  order_payment_det as (
    select 
        order_id,
        sum(payment_value) as total_payment_value
    from "ecommerce_db"."intermediate"."int_order_payments"
    group by 1
  )

select 
    o.*,
    r.avg_review_score,
    r.total_reviews,
    p.total_payment_value
from orders o 
left join order_review_agg r using (order_id)
left join order_payment_det p using (order_id)
